contexts.text: They call these things metaphysics and logic... SE 4446.
They had been logicians and metaphysicians... SE 3947.
Which remain no longer than while things analytical and metaphysical are in the thought.
What then is a universal Providence than a metaphysical word...
Among them were some who had been metaphysicians and Scholastics...
One was found skilled in the metaphysical art, who could turn the ideas of things into ideas of terms, and hide the things themselves under formulas...
Because it is a metaphysical word...
They murmured some terms borrowed from the metaphysical art...
But as these things are metaphysical, they cannot but be in thick darkness...
Who can (convert the idea of three gods into the idea of one God) by what is metaphysical which transcends the apprehension?
I said, What need is there of the metaphysical term essence... Can you ever think metaphysically?
The three Persons... are conjoined into one metaphysical God...
How can the metaphysical term essence make one out of three?
